programs.title: Red One
programs.desc: The third joint film of Jake Kasdan and Dwayne Johnson, after two installments of the new version of "Jumanji".The head of North Pole security and a bounty hunter search for the missing Santa Claus.

programs.title: Ford v Ferrari
programs.desc: The victory in the prestigious race goes to the Ferrari team every year.Henry Ford II intends to dethrone the full-time champion.He thinks about building a car that will leave the competition behind.For this purpose, he asks for help from two specialists.One of them is the temperamental fast driving enthusiast Ken Miles.The second one is Carroll Shelby, who can boast of winning Le Mans, and some time ago, due to health problems, he gave up his driving career and took up car design.They both immediately take up the challenge, even though they know that there is a long way to achieve their goal.They quickly encounter resistance from officials.It turns out that they must immerse themselves in the world of ruthless bureaucracy to take part in the twenty-four-hour race.

programs.title: Veep 5
programs.desc: The story of Vice President Selina Meyer (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) continues, as she and her colleagues want to achieve something significant in politics.The woman avoids deals, scandals and corruption.She is assisted in her daily work by Amy, her office manager (Anna Chlumsky), spokesman Mike McLintock (Matt Walsh), general counsel Gary (Tony Hale) and secretary Sue (Sufe Bradshaw).When Selina Meyer unexpectedly takes over as president after her predecessor stepped down, the entire team must face a new challenge.

programs.title: Birdman: Or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)
programs.desc: Riggan Thomson (Michael Keaton) once gained fame as the main actor in a series of films about the adventures of a superhero called Birdman.Currently, the aging Riggan is working on a play that he intends to put on Broadway.He is both its director and the main actor.During rehearsal, one of the actors has an accident.The injured party's successor, Mike (Edward Norton), does not want to submit to the director's vision.Riggan's lover, Laura (Andrea Riseborough), tells him that she is pregnant with his child.His daughter Sam (Emma Stone), a recovered drug addict, also requires support.Soon the actor's dark alter ego begins to reveal itself.The film received four Oscars, including:as the best film.

programs.title: Isle of Dogs
programs.desc: The futuristic city of Megasaki in Japan.In the face of a dog flu epidemic, the corrupt Mayor Kobayashi declares a state of emergency and issues a decree under which all dogs are to be quarantined, i.e. sent to an island covered with garbage.The immediate implementation of the order arouses rebellion in twelve-year-old Atari, who thus loses his four-legged friend.However, the boy does not want to give up so easily, he steals a small flying machine and goes to the island to find Ciapek.Once there, he asks for help from a pack of neglected, hungry dogs who are looking for food among the garbage.Together with his new friends, he sets out to find his ward.The film received two Oscar nominations.He was also nominated, among others:to the Golden Globes and BAFTA awards.The animation director is the winner of many awards, for this production he was also honored with the Silver Bear at the Berlinale festival.
